acceptanceCriteria.title: One canonical tracker
acceptanceCriteria.acceptance: Deterministic current projection; exact archived status bytes; independent evidence classes and dependency references validated.

acceptanceCriteria.title: Customer-first entry and project/field selection
acceptanceCriteria.acceptance: Real Sign in precedes customer-first Home. Include actual zero-project customers; select their projects and fields, browse without replacing work, explicitly Open, and create/edit permitted customers/projects while preserving unfinished context.

acceptanceCriteria.title: Truthful account sign-in and shared service
acceptanceCriteria.acceptance: Actual server authentication/authorization and durable customer/project service preserve cache/recovery/import contracts. Additive catalog-metadata reads one authorized workspace snapshot under its rowlock, including empty customers/archive inheritance/revision and actual principalId/policyRevision; SDK validates captured account/policy before publication and mismatch uses the preserving account_changed path. Existing project endpoint remains compatible; actor attribution is final-lock bound.

acceptanceCriteria.title: Logical customer/project/field folders and actual field content
acceptanceCriteria.acceptance: One authorized customer snapshot includes empty customers. Actual customer→project→field links determine logical folders. Machine/map-design categories address existing saved document/machine content without copied entities or invented types; field Surveys identify their saved review/included collections and official maps appear only under the actual matched Survey. Historical parent-unavailable/unqualified records remain distinct and readable/exportable.

acceptanceCriteria.title: Optional Design and required Survey
acceptanceCriteria.acceptance: New project opens Design; manual drawing needs no receiver; direct Survey entry allowed; Layout requires matching saved Survey qualification.

acceptanceCriteria.title: Manual field and machine geometry
acceptanceCriteria.acceptance: Interactive map accepts manual boundaries and relevant lines/points with purpose, undo, persistence and no GNSS requirement.

acceptanceCriteria.title: Receiver collection and qualification
acceptanceCriteria.acceptance: Field Survey anchors the actual saved review and included collections/source revision. Live collection requires fresh owned RTK Fixed receiver epochs and admitted actual CRS; manual/planned points retain their separate provenance.

acceptanceCriteria.title: Official Layout maps under matched Survey with RTK admission
acceptanceCriteria.acceptance: V3 RTK Layout creation, live marking and finalization each require fresh owned Fixed final admission with matched Survey/source/revision/CRS. Official finalization binds every immutable target to an actual within-tolerance station and exact observations. Preserve creation/finalization/reference metadata in all writers; noV3→V2 downgrade. Original authorized GET/view/export remains; V3bulk/raw import without service/workspace/account origin proof refuses, same-original-field dedicated reference import retains exact target/review IDs/raw source without inherited finalization, and cross-field reference import refuses. Planned targets/manual provenance remain distinct from measured stations and physical qualification.

acceptanceCriteria.title: Retain ancestors referenced by saved Survey evidence
acceptanceCriteria.acceptance: Future ancestor deletion refuses whenever active or archived retained Survey evidence references its field. Preserve original saved owner/collection/point bytes and schemas; historical orphans remain readable/exportable with parent unavailable, without guessed placement or cascade deletion.

acceptanceCriteria.title: Preserve current and unfinished work
acceptanceCriteria.acceptance: Mode/context changes retain raw input, camera, history, saved identity and conflicts; restoration never silently saves/reconnects. All shared writers retain officialV3creation/finalization/reference metadata and exact source history; authenticated receipt actors remain bound to admitted account/policy after nested/awaited locks.

acceptanceCriteria.title: Production operator wording
acceptanceCriteria.acceptance: All operator surfaces use clear business language; availability and errors remain actionable; developer diagnostics stay outside ordinary flow.

acceptanceCriteria.title: Guides, sources and delegated review
acceptanceCriteria.acceptance: One current guide accurately states customer→project→field/content→matched Survey/official Layout hierarchy, optional Design, RTK admission, retained ancestors and source/browser/native/field/publication boundaries; historical questionnaires are not new gates.

acceptanceCriteria.title: Installed mitigation and compatible updates
acceptanceCriteria.acceptance: Exact-lock install and installed target checks pass; raw audit and local mitigations recorded separately; compatible updates run full affected checks.

acceptanceCriteria.title: Recurring dependency reports and update PRs
acceptanceCriteria.acceptance: Daily security/outdated reports and weekly grouped npm/actions PR configuration; exact-head CI/independent compatibility review precede coordinator merge.

acceptanceCriteria.title: Truthful selected capability inventory
acceptanceCriteria.acceptance: All 67 exposed host plus 11 local skill sources documented; source presence, validation and actual invocation remain distinct.

acceptanceCriteria.title: Source-bound hook execution qualification
acceptanceCriteria.acceptance: Only supported source-bound probes establish actual event execution; Stop remains disabled; private failure paths are bounded.

acceptanceCriteria.title: Verified retirement without data loss
acceptanceCriteria.acceptance: Reference/provenance/ownership/recovery checks precede retirement; no existing source deletion qualifies; frozen readers and failed/deferred proof preserved.

acceptanceCriteria.title: Complete workflow proof and review
acceptanceCriteria.acceptance: Current clarified customer/field/Survey/official-map and retained-ancestry source/API/App proof against a complete canonical census; responsive/accessibility/failure coverage; two complete independent reviews with no unresolved defects. Historical passes or incomplete scopes do not qualify the new edition.

acceptanceCriteria.title: Reviewable source publication
acceptanceCriteria.acceptance: Review exact changed paths, commit/push normally, require exact-head protected CI and independent review; current checkpoint never relabeled production release.

qualification: Frozen source and criteria census only. Commands, browser cases, independent reviews, deployment, native devices and physical accuracy require their own actual evidence.
